definition: the first time I went down to the foundations, and what that dig was made of

settled:
I actually did go deep into this. I spent most of college focusing on the foundations.

I did the equivalent of a BS in religion studies, majored in math, minored in logic.

This time feels different though.

What is different is the instrument I bring rather than the question. So the re-examination is not driven by having never looked.

title: The College Years I Spent On The Foundations
